title: A Monster in the Park (1)
paras: I heard a splash! A splatter!
I heard a soft giggle, quiet chatter.
But, who's behind this playground clatter?
It's strange. It's odd. It's a mystery — these sounds.
Because whoever made them is nowhere to be found.
The swings are empty. The jungle gym is bare.
I search the monkey bars and merry-go-round.
I climb to the top of the rock wall to get a better view.
I look high, I look low.
Then I spy it. A clue!
Muddy tracks trail down the soccer field and over the tennis court.
They're stamped down the sidewalk and circle around the park.
I saw tracks everywhere from up there on the wall.
But, there's one place that looked the messiest of all.

scan.a: the top of the rock wall

tf.en: I found the one who made the sounds.

notes.scan: 네 문항 중 셋이 답을 두 개 찾는 문항입니다. 하나만 찾아도 충분히 잘한 거예요 — 같은 문장에서 나머지를 더 찾게 해 보세요.
notes.tf: 2번과 4번은 지문을 거꾸로 뒤집었습니다. 이 이야기는 소리는 들리는데 아무도 안 보이는 것이 핵심이라, "찾았어? 못 찾았어?"를 짚어 주면 이야기 전체가 잡힙니다.
notes.trace: 운문이라 쉼표가 많습니다. 쉼표 자리를 빠뜨리지 않았는지 봐 주세요.
